plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: I wanted four checks the library does not offer. (1) A check of each case's category against the requester's rule, customer by customer. (2) A check that ties the live tables to the staged set directly, instead of relying only on the promotion's line in the record. (3) A per-customer view of which rows changed. (4) A way to tell a preview call from a send call other than inferring it from a missing outbox row. The plan adds 'summary of the change' at A1 (14), which checks that no other table or column is touched, that no row is deleted and that 100 rows hold the status value the agreement fixes. It also adds 'trace of an action' at A3 (5), which settles send calls that were ordered and not confirmed, using the outbox and the environment's two guarantees. The plan costs 119 of the 200 allowed. I added nothing at A2. 'Same set' and 'summary of the change' would only repeat what they said at A1. Another undo rehearsal could not show that the promotion is reversible beyond the time it ran, and costs a lot. I keep most of the 50-unit allowance for a new 'undo rehearsal' or 'trace of an action' if the record calls for one.
